rows.en:
(I heard our class was running a cafe
as its event this year, but...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Culture Fest class attraction (dashimono). 'cafe' without accent (Shift-JIS).

rows.en: Welcome home, Master!
rows.notes: Ranka, maid-cafe greeting (goshujin-sama); the female version c23147 uses 'Milady'.

rows.en: Welcome to the 'Galactic Fairy' Cafe!
rows.notes: Sheryl; shared male/female. The cafe is named after her title.

rows.en: Oh, wait... It's just \p.

(So it's a cafe, all right...
a maid cafe...)

What are you spacing out for?!
We're almost out of time before we open.
Hurry up and get ready!
rows.notes: Sheryl to the player; shared male/female.

rows.en:
Welcome hoooome~~!!
Will it be tea? Will it be swee~ts?
Or perhaps... my-sel......
rows.notes: Hoshimura; shared male/female. The classic 'bath, dinner, or me (a-ta-shi)?' gag, cut off after 'a-ta'; cut 'myself' at the matching point.

rows.en:
...Hoshimura, you're the one who remodeled
the classroom, right?

Yep, that's right!
A job like this is a cinch for yours truly!
rows.notes: Hoshimura; shared. 'Yours truly' for her old-fashioned voice.

rows.en:
(Like last year, can you really call this
just a remodel? I can see the ocean and
an artificial island outside...)
(Oh well... Better not dig too deep!)

I'm counting on you today,
\p-kun.

Huh?! Claire-senpai!
If you're wearing a maid outfit, then...

Yes, I came to lend a hand today.
Klan came along to help too.

That said, it looks like Klan came
for another reason rather than to help...
Another reason?
That. Over there.
Welcome home, young master.
rows.notes: Michel in a butler outfit (obocchama); female version c23154 'my lady'.

rows.en: A b-butler outfit...?!

Miyuki got them ready to bring in
a wider range of customers.
rows.notes: Michel; shared. Kyakusou wo fuyasu = broaden the clientele.

rows.en:
Though apparently she couldn't rent many
butler outfits, so there aren't a lot of them.

Hmph! Even you clean up nice
in the right clothes, Michel!
rows.notes: Klan; shared. Mago nimo ishou (even a packhorse driver looks fine in good clothes): a backhanded compliment.

rows.en:
But you in that butler outfit...
I-it doesn't NOT suit you!!
rows.notes: Klan; shared. Niattenaku mo nai = the grudging double negative kept.

rows.en:
And your maid outfit...
Well, it's not bad, I guess.
R-really...?

(They could just compliment each other
like normal people...)

Those two really
can't be honest, can they?
Tell me about it...
Oh, you're in a butler outfit too, Luca.

Yes, for some reason there was one in my size,
so I figured I'd better wear it...

I see.
Huh? Come to think of it, where's Alto?
Alto-senpai is over there.

Oh, a butler outfit.
And here I was sure...

'I thought Alto would be in a maid outfit'...
Is that what you were about to say,
\p?
rows.notes: Alto. The quote is in his own words (third person), as in the Japanese.

rows.en: N-no way, of course not...
Hmph! Good, then.
You look pretty sharp in that, Alto.
Uh-huh, you look so cool, Alto-kun!

You think? I'd say your maid outfits
suit you pretty well too...
rows.notes: Alto to Sheryl and Ranka; shared.

rows.en: Oh... Why, you think so...?
Aw, you're making me blush, Alto-kun...

But Alto, between Ranka-chan and me in our
maid outfits... I look better, don't I?

Ranka-chan's just sort of...
lacking in sex appeal, isn't she?
rows.notes: Sheryl; shared. Iroke ga nai, kept at full strength.

rows.en:
I-I don't think having a great figure
is everything!

Pushing your chest out for no reason
is kind of vulgar... or, how do I put it......

V-vulgar...
You've got some nerve, Ranka-chan.
Alto! Hurry up and say who looks better!

Huh?! W-well, let's see...
Hey, \p...
rows.notes: Alto, looking to the player for help; shared.

rows.en: I'd better go get ready for opening...
Hey, don't run away!
Alto!
(Alto sure has it rough...)

(Right, I'd better hurry and get ready too,
or we won't be open in time.)

(Sheryl Nome's pull is really something.
The response is so huge we're swamped.)

\p-kun,
please take the order at table 5.

Sure, got it.
By the way, Nanase, you've been working
nonstop this whole time. Aren't you tired?

I'm fine!
Just getting to see Ranka-san in a maid
outfit is enough for me...
Well, I'll go put the order through!

\p-kun,
please take this to table 3.

Roger.
Are you okay too, Akimizu? You've been
working nonstop this whole time...

No problem at all!
Just getting to see Claire-senpai in a maid
outfit is enough for me...
I'll go take the order at table 5!

(How should I put it...
those two run on the same fuel...)

You keep worrying about everyone else,
but what about you, \p-kun?
Aren't you tired?

I'm fine.
What about you, Shirakawa? Are you okay?

Yes. I may not look it,
but I have plenty of stamina.
rows.notes: Shirakawa; shared. Kore demo = despite appearances.

rows.en:
In that case, the one who doesn't
seem okay is...
Pinon-chan, I suppose...

She's been working so hard with that
little body of hers...
Hey, Pinon-chan!

Huff, huff... What is it... \p...
I'm incredibly busy right now......
You look tired. Take a little break.

Wh-what are you talking about?!
Huff, huff... I'm not tired at all!

(She's definitely overdoing it.
She won't take a break no matter what I say,
so in that case...)

Pinon-chan...
If you say you won't take a break...
If I say that, then what?
Claire-senpaaai!
What is it, \p-kun?

Pinon-chan says she wants to sleep over
at your place tonight, Claire-senpai!
In her maid outfit, of course...
rows.notes: Shared. Claire-senpai no ie = 'your place, Claire-senpai' since the player is talking to her.

rows.en:
...I-is that true, Pinon-chan?!
Of course it's fine by me!
Hehe, the two of us in the same bed...
Eek!!

uncertain: c23056: Hoshimura's cut-off 'a-ta(shi)' gag rendered 'my-sel......' (shared male/female).
